Given two sets A and B , if A ∩ B | ∅ (that is, if there is no element in common to both A and B ), then | A ∪ B | | | A | + | B | . This hardly needs a proof. To find A ∪ B , you take everything in A and throw in everything in B . Since there is no element in both sets already, you will have | A | things and add | B | new things to it. This is what adding does!
